body:
Fixes two problems at the upper boundary and with tracer-mass consistency
* Ensures zero mass flux through top boundary even in the presence of warped coordinate surfaces (before the flux would only be zero if top layers are level)
* Ensures tracer-mass consistency in EDMF by treating all tracers (e.g., condensates) like `mse` and `q_tot`, in difference form, with corresponding Jacobian updates. Reduces SGS mass-flux tendency with an artificially uniform `q_lcl` from 1.1e-7 to 6.7e-14 (Float32 roundoff).

commits.messageBody:
Over sloped terrain-following coordinates (g³ʰ ≠ 0 at the lid, e.g. with
Linear mesh warping), ᶠwinterp's Extrapolate top BC copies the topmost
cell-center uₕ³ to the top face, so zeroing only the covariant u₃ left
ᶠu³ = ᶠuₕ³ ≠ 0 there, and the continuity equation (which used the
unrestricted ᶜdivᵥ while all tracers use ᶜadvdivᵥ) consumed that flux as
a spurious mass leak through the lid.

Mirror the surface treatment at the top: set_velocity_at_top! now takes
ᶠuₕ³ and sets top_u₃ = -uₕ³/g³³ (new top_velocity helper, analogous to
surface_velocity), so the total contravariant flux vanishes exactly at
the lid. Since all EDMFX subdomain velocities are built from the same
grid-mean uₕ and ᶠuₕ³, copying top_u₃ into each u₃ʲ keeps ᶠu³ʲ = 0 too.

Independently, switch the continuity equation to ᶜadvdivᵥ so the zero
boundary flux is structural rather than dependent on the state filter,
restoring the χ ≡ 1 tracer-mass identity at the boundary rows and making
the ρ-row Jacobian (already built from ᶜadvdivᵥ_matrix) exact.

A regression test in advection_tests.jl asserts that ᶠu³ vanishes at
both boundary faces over a Schar mountain with Linear warping, where
ᶠuₕ³ ≠ 0 at the lid.

Validated on a Schar-mountain plane with Linear warping: top-face u³
drops from 6.5e-6 to machine zero and the total-mass drift from
-7.8e-13 per 10 steps to exactly 0.

commits.messageHeadline: Enforce u³ = 0 at the model top and zero-flux continuity boundaries

commits.messageBody:
…flux

Transport the auto-discovered SGS tracers (q_lcl, q_icl, q_rai, q_sno,
n_*) the same way as mse and q_tot: grid-mean vertical advection (now
applied unconditionally in explicit_vertical_advection_tendency!) plus
difference-form SGS corrections ρᵏaᵏ(u³ᵏ - u³)(χᵏ - χ), which vanish
identically for uniform χ. Previously these tracers were transported by
absolute subdomain fluxes Σₖ ρᵏaᵏ u³ᵏ χᵏ that replaced the grid-mean
advection entirely; the discrete sum does not telescope to the
continuity flux (upwound area fractions vs centrally interpolated ρ,
ρᵏ ≠ ρ, and regularized u₃⁰/χ⁰), producing a spurious source/sink of
each species where updraft area varies strongly and a drift of the
water-species partition relative to q_tot by numerics alone.

Update the manual Jacobian tracer blocks to the difference-form
derivatives: the upwind matrices are built with u³ᵏ - u³; the draft
loop gains a ∂/∂ρχ entry (-aʲ/ρ); the environment ∂/∂ρχ entry gains
the -a⁰/ρ correction; and the ∂/∂u₃ entries use the velocity-difference
sensitivities (-g³³ for drafts, (ᶠinterp(ρ/ρa⁰) - 1)g³³ for the
environment).

Also add the moist-air-mass counterpart of the SGS q_tot mass flux:
Yₜ.c.ρ receives the same tendency as Yₜ.c.ρq_tot from both the updraft
and environment contributions, mirroring the diffusive-flux treatment,
so vertical SGS redistribution of water also redistributes moist air
mass term-by-term.

With a spun-up DYCOMS RF01 EDMFX 1M column, the SGS tendency of a
uniform tracer drops from ~10% of the q_tot flux scale to roundoff.

commits.messageBody:
The -β·ρq_x damping of the 1M species has no counterpart in ρq_tot, ρ,
or ρe_tot, so it acts as saturation-blind condensate-to-vapor
conversion in the sponge layer. Flag it for removal (if unneeded after
the top-boundary fixes) or for a mass- and energy-consistent
reformulation.

commits.messageBody:
The new test asserts the χ ≡ 1 identity for the fixed transport
pathways: ∂(ρq_x)/∂t = ∂ρ/∂t for uniform tracers through the implicit
and explicit advection pathways; bitwise equality of the ρ and ρq_tot
tendencies from the EDMFX SGS mass flux; and vanishing difference-form
SGS fluxes for uniform tracers. Each assertion fails on the pre-fix
code.

Increment the reproducibility reference counter (371 -> 372): the
boundary and SGS transport fixes intentionally change simulation
output.
